content.user_title: Improve AI Communication With Human Readers
content.value_statement: AI responses can miss how people read, express preferences, and interpret context. This skill guides clearer structure, concrete drafts, and feedback that preserves user decisions.
actual_capabilities: Guide explanations with headings, lists, examples, and one independent judgment per sentence.
Encourage concrete drafts that help users recognize and express preferences.
Distinguish routine choices from decisions that change the user objective.
Interpret feedback beyond the single sentence a user identifies.
Use user reactions to clarify missing contextual cues.
Explain why additional reasoning may not resolve missing social context.
limitations: Provides prose guidance, not executable tools or automated readability checks.
Refers to separate writing and skill-authoring skills for detailed procedures.
Cannot reliably infer unstated intentions; user clarification remains necessary.
Applies visual benchmark observations to text by analogy, not direct validation.

use_cases.title: Clarify team documentation
use_cases.description: Review a team update for hidden assumptions, crowded sentences, and decisions that readers may overlook.

use_cases.title: Elicit product preferences
use_cases.description: Present a concrete proposal so stakeholders can respond to specific choices while retaining control over project objectives.

use_cases.title: Apply feedback consistently
use_cases.description: Explore why a reviewer rejected one instruction and identify other passages affected by the same concern.

prompt_templates.title: Make a message easier to read
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this message for human readers: [message]. Separate independent judgments and add headings or examples where helpful. Preserve the meaning.

prompt_templates.title: Create a draft for feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a proposal for [goal] using [constraints]. Identify assumptions and decisions that change my objective. Ask for feedback on those decisions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn an unclear request into a concrete proposal.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret a review comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [document] alongside this feedback: [comment]. Suggest the underlying concern and other affected passages. Distinguish evidence from assumptions and request clarification where needed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: apply a review concern across a document.

prompt_templates.title: Review a collaborative workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [workflow] for readability, implicit context, and user decision ownership. Propose a concrete revision. Separate routine choices from objective-changing decisions and identify questions requiring confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: improve a complete human and AI collaboration process.

output_examples.input: Improve this update: We changed the schedule and scope, so review everything and tell us what you think.
output: Schedule: The delivery date has changed. State the previous and proposed dates.
Scope: List the included and excluded work separately.
Decision needed: Ask whether the proposed date or the reduced scope should take priority.

output_examples.input: A reviewer says one instruction assumes too much context. How should I respond?
output: Possible concern: The instruction depends on information that the reader has not received.
Review other instructions for the same assumption and propose explicit context where needed.
Show the reviewer a revised example and ask whether it addresses the concern.

output_examples.input: Help me choose a workshop format when I cannot yet describe my preferences.
output: Draft: Begin with a short demonstration, follow with guided practice, and finish with discussion.
Assumption: Participants need practical experience more than broad coverage.
Decision for you: Is practical experience the main objective, or should the workshop prioritize an overview?

best_practices: Provide the audience, objective, and a concrete draft before requesting revisions.
Confirm inferred intentions with the user before changing decisions that affect their objective.
Check whether feedback reveals a concern that applies elsewhere in the document.
anti_patterns: Treating general statements about human reading as universal facts about every reader.
Asking only abstract questions when a concrete proposal would help users express preferences.
Changing user objectives based on inferred context without confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides guidance on human reading, preference expression, and contextual understanding to improve AI communication.

faq.question: Does it include scripts or automated checks?
faq.answer: No. The supplied skill consists of one Markdown guidance file.

faq.question: Can it determine what a user really means?
faq.answer: No. It encourages interpreting context and testing assumptions through concrete drafts and user feedback.

faq.question: Does it replace the related writing skills?
faq.answer: No. It supplies underlying principles and refers to writing and skill-authoring for detailed procedures.

faq.question: Does the benchmark prove better writing performance?
faq.answer: No. The file describes a visual benchmark and explicitly treats its application to text as an analogy.

faq.question: Is an external service required?
faq.answer: No external service is required by the instructions. The included URL is a reference citation, not an integration.
